title: Pension Funds Act 24 of 1956
verified_how: Fetched the gov.za page. Title is 'Pension Funds Act 24 of 1956'. Commencement: 1 January 1958. Amended by Pension Funds Amendment Act 31 of 2024 among others.
notes: Regulates private occupational retirement funds. The two-pot system came in through the 2024 amendments.
